basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old software developer from São Paulo, Brazil, who recently discovered the world of Reddit. I have a passion for golf and makeup, which might seem like an unusual combination, but I love balancing my time between the greens and creative makeup looks. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my weekends exploring new golf courses or trying out makeup tutorials. My typical online hours are in the evenings after work, usually between 6 PM and 10 PM local time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and work as a software developer. My knowledge in golf comes from years of playing with friends and watching online tutorials. As for makeup, I've been mostly self-taught, inspired by online creators and Reddit communities.
